name: RAJESH RACHAKONDA
title: ==TEST AUTOMATION LEAD==  |  SENIOR SOFTWARE TEST ENGINEER

sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.body: Accomplished ==Test Automation Lead== and Senior Software Test Engineer with **18+ years** of comprehensive experience designing, planning, and executing end-to-end test programs across mission-critical public sector and secure enterprise environments. Proven track record leading the transformation of testing into a continuous and efficient quality engineering function. Expert in ==Functional Test Planning==, implementing quality processes, and evaluating bespoke and COTS software engineering solutions to assure strict compliance with functional and non-functional requirements.

sections.heading: CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
rows: Test Design & Architecture, Testing Strategies, ==Functional== & Non-Functional Testing, ==Quality Assurance Methodologies==, Defect Lifecycle Management, Agile/Scrum, RTM.
==Automated Testing Frameworks==, CI/CD Pipeline QA, UFT/QTP, ==Selenium==, UNIX Shell Scripting, Object-Oriented Concepts (Java, C++), JavaScript, VBScript
==Influencing & Advisory Skills==, ==Team Decisions==, Cross-team engagement, Stakeholder Communication, ==Test Result Analysis & Actionable Insights==
Postman, SoapUI, RESTful APIs, SOAP/WSDL, XML, JSON, OAuth2, Bearer Tokens, SAML, SSO Authentication, ADFS, Identity APIs (MyID, MyGov)
Bespoke Systems, COTS Integration, Secure Data Exchange, Cross Domain Solution (CDS) Concepts
Linux (RHEL, Solaris, Unix), Windows, Network Diagnostics (Cisco, TCP/IP, Wireshark/tcpdump)
Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, Teradata, Complex Multi-Table Joins, Azure DevOps, Jira, HP ALM/QC, TFS, SAP S/4 HANA
sections.note: Highlighted areas map directly to Accenture's explicitly requested skills: Functional Test Planning (Must Have), Automated Testing Frameworks (Good To Have), and Leadership/Advisory capabilities.

Formulated and executed complex SQL queries on Microsoft SQL Server 18 to verify transaction integrity.
